# Synthetic monthly fixture

All names, amounts and documents are fabricated for tests. The XML is a deliberately small UBL syntax example, not a certified EN 16931/XRechnung invoice. The PDF is a training letter, not a real notice or sourced legal deadline. The bank export has two explicitly linked test ledger movements and a third unmatched payment requiring a receipt. No real tax IDs, IBANs or credentials are present.
